anatomical_identity_review.source_scope: HBAO 2025-02-10, Allen StructureGraph 10; not Allen 3D 2020 or Ding 2016 as interchangeable geometries.
anatomical_identity_review.laterality: 73 unspecified identities remain not_established; two source-explicit side-specific subthalamic nuclei. Six unsupported input midline assignments withdrawn; no invented hemisphere mirrors.
anatomical_identity_review.deduplication: Native HBA identity and source version; exact labels/acronyms/parent IDs checked. Uberon subclass crosswalks deferred; no uncertain equivalence merges.
anatomical_identity_review.publication_decision: All 75 anatomies DEFERRED for commercial rights; identities remain scientifically verified, source_checked staging research.

hierarchy_review.primary_parent_policy: One exact asserted BFO:0000050 immediate parent per nonroot; all endpoints in selected source tree.
hierarchy_review.claim_specific_provenance: Every row gives exact HBA subject/object and predicate plus Allen parent ID. Source-specific annotation semantics explicitly qualified.
cautions: Gray/white branches are source annotation organization, not a claim that a regional structure contains only one tissue type.
Mesencephalon/myelencephalon source terms are not silently renamed adult midbrain/medulla or assigned a newly invented brainstem parent.
hierarchy_review.commercial_rights_gate: BLOCKED_UNRESOLVED; no reviewed hierarchy is serialized in staging records.

network_review.decision: Seven reviewed method/version-qualified definition candidates; no membership publication candidates.
network_review.corrections: Ordered labels 4 and 6 are Salience / Ventral Attention and Control. Inherited ventral-attention/frontoparietal slugs retained as technical provenance, not evidence of equivalence.
network_review.conflicts: Seeley salience/executive-control networks and Schaefer parcels are not silently equated to the Yeo seven labels.

functional_association_review.decision: No functional association staged. Later evidence prevents broad undifferentiated region/construct claims.

independent_research_log.finding: Pinned HBAO labels/edges and live Allen graph independently agree for all 75 selected identities; explicit upstream BFO relation used.
Ding 2017 DOI/PMID is a correction to Ding 2016 despite the identical title; retained separately.
Publisher/professional Persian texts attest four selected labels and one transliteration. Other candidates withheld.
Bo 2024 and Radua 2025 change the interpretation of older reappraisal/conditioning findings; positive generic edges deferred.
Ontology CC BY 4.0, Uberon CC BY 3.0, pinned CBIG MIT and Allen 3D-specific CC BY 4.0 confirmed. NIMH image exception preserved.

Allen current research/noncommercial terms checked against HBAO provenance; commercial use confirmed possible by user. Anatomical candidates deferred. HOMBA 2026 and AHRAv2 documented as distinct deferred alternatives, not silent replacements.

deferred_research.reason: Useful ventricular system identities; selected brain-root hierarchy does not supply a justified immediate native parent. Do not invent containment.
Competing granularity/definitions and educational value need a separate scoped atlas review.
Lesion network evidence uses normative connectivity and symptom-specific samples; no causal or generic network membership inferred.
Distinct templates, subject material, corrected labels and atlas versions require explicit spatial mappings; no masks or coordinates bundled.
Mirrored/resized atlas-derived geometry, not anatomical measurement; detailed HBAO crosswalk and third-party notices pending. Nothing downloaded or redistributed.
Persian clinical reports support terminology only; no diagnostic or disorder association promoted.
Publisher figures, ISUOG redistribution, older Persian article visual rights, MNI template and third-party meshes need their own rights review.

unresolved_issues: Commercial use is possible/undecided. Allen-derived anatomy, aliases, native IDs and hierarchy remain publication-blocked until an applicable commercial exception or source/rightsholder clarification is established.
78 Persian identity terms have no independently substantiated equivalent and remain blank.
No human neuroanatomist or Persian terminology specialist sign-off is claimed; this is a source-grounded candidate dossier for publication review.
General Uberon equivalence, HBAO-to-Yeo memberships, ventricular parentage and competing atlas boundaries deferred.
Magiran source lead lacks primary publisher verification; excluded from staging source rows.
All visual assets and source-content redistribution await file-specific rights checks; no such assets included.
Current promoter remains read-only with its infrastructure blocked_missing_curated_dossier label; no automatic publication authorized.

records.definition: Ordered label 5 (Limbic) in the Yeo2011 seven-network cortical solution distributed in CBIG v0.19.2-Yeo2011_Schaefer2018. Scope is surface-based cerebral cortex; group boundaries cannot be transferred to HBAO units or individual subjects without evidence.
records.method: Intrinsic/resting-state functional connectivity MRI; 1,000 participants; surface-based alignment and clustering with replicated cortical network solutions. Limits: group-level, method-dependent, seven versus seventeen solutions differ; no subcortical or causal interpretation.
